# capture_snapshot measured on gpgx (spec 008, TP-302, Tessera v0.2.0-rc.3).
# Written by tools/diffbench/compare_recompose_stats.py --update; the native
# side runs the same cases in tests/integration/md_subscriptions_test.cpp.
# c[out_size] captures the snapshot; G<id> reads 0 bytes of a region and
# prints the generation it answers. Generations print from the first one seen
# in the case ("+N"): the absolute value also counts the host's loading steps.
# audio-flood starts at frame 1: the first frame's write count is EXC-007.

case raster-bands-1 0 0:c.G1;1:c;2:c.c47.c48.c100 3
frame=0 c status=0 size=48 version=1 generation=+0 frame_generation=1 flags=1 overflow=0 fallback=0 sprites=0 audio=0 reserved=0
frame=0 G1 status=-9
frame=1 c status=0 size=48 version=1 generation=+1 frame_generation=2 flags=1 overflow=0 fallback=0 sprites=0 audio=0 reserved=0
frame=2 c status=0 size=48 version=1 generation=+2 frame_generation=3 flags=1 overflow=0 fallback=0 sprites=0 audio=0 reserved=0
frame=2 c47 status=-3 size=1515870810 version=1515870810 generation=6510615555426900570 frame_generation=6510615555426900570 flags=5a5a5a5a overflow=5a5a5a5a fallback=5a5a5a5a sprites=1515870810 audio=1515870810 reserved=5a5a5a5a
frame=2 c48 status=0 size=48 version=1 generation=+2 frame_generation=3 flags=1 overflow=0 fallback=0 sprites=0 audio=0 reserved=0
frame=2 c100 status=0 size=48 version=1 generation=+2 frame_generation=3 flags=1 overflow=0 fallback=0 sprites=0 audio=0 reserved=0
end

frame=2 c status=0 size=48 version=1 generation=+2 frame_generation=3 flags=1 overflow=0 fallback=2 sprites=0 audio=0 reserved=0
